<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Monetary Policy Outlook:</strong> Analysts and research firms, including BofA and UBS, project the RBI may hike interest rates by up to 75 basis points in the coming months to combat rising inflation.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwgFBVV95cUxOX0NCc25kTFgybXFka2VpR2NoazBHVks2NG1JX3Q3d3dSM3kydU0xa1hDVTNVUjNqb01Rc3NMamM0cFdNQVJkTWkzLWJ4dTF6ZHRDZjFoY3ZXaVlFTFNtcmZRRFMtOEJFWGJkVDMyVk5RYUQxOXpFRHpXT3NWUTkxV3lCelp6em5yUncwMTJPNUkwTURkSGhocnNVZDJxNlh1dzlEYUktTldXbC1YWEQ1eV9wMmFJcHNyZFJ1dDlkb0tjdw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I16</a></span></li>

</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Energy and Market Sentiment:</strong> Asian markets are experiencing a downturn as crude oil prices remain elevated above $105–$106 per barrel, creating a challenging backdrop for Indian equities.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Geopolitical Pressures:</strong> Global sentiment remains fragile due to ongoing geopolitical conflicts and a strong US dollar, which continues to weigh on foreign institutional investor (FII) flows into Indian markets.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W11</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W12</a></span></li>
